19.text: Nvidia raised fiscal 2028 revenue growth guidance to about 75%, implying roughly $741 billion, after fiscal Q3 revenue rose 103% to $115.8 billion. Shares sit about 35% below their record high, and analysts are split on valuation, with price targets ranging from $125 to $250.

6.text: AMD shares fell sharply amid an AI chip sector sell-off, with analysts debating whether the drop is a buying opportunity. AMD reported 97% year-over-year data center revenue growth to $8.5 billion and expects server revenues to double in 2027.

22.text: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO after an 11-day resignation amid a spy scandal, drawing scrutiny from Congress, the SEC, and crisis experts. Huang denies Trump pressured the board, apologized to staff, and still faces a China chip-smuggling probe.

15.text: Broadcom's AI chip revenue is accelerating, with its stock down 27% from June and below $290 ahead of its Dec. 9 earnings. Other articles favor TSMC, Marvell, Arm, Cerebras, and On Semiconductor over Nvidia, which is mentioned only as a comparison.

11.text: Neocloud stocks fell sharply on financing and interest-rate concerns: Nebius dropped 16% Friday and 6% Wednesday, while CoreWeave briefly traded below its $40 IPO price despite 168% revenue growth. CoreWeave posted MLPerf benchmarks using Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72, and both firms remain far below highs.

8.text: Semiconductor ETFs SOXX and DRAM fell sharply amid a Nasdaq correction, which the articles attribute partly to Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO. They frame this as context for recommending a Vanguard growth-stock ETF as an alternative.
